title: Custom DirectX 12 build for Godot crashes & won't start
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.beta.custom_build
- Not reproducible in: Any official build, any build which isn't built for DX12

### System information

Windows 10 - v4.5.beta.custom_build - D3D12 11_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Intel - Intel(R) HD Graphics 5500 - Laptop

### Issue description

I made a custom build for Godot for DX12. Took around 19 hours & 20 minutes. Now when I try to run it, it gives the following error:

### Steps to reproduce

Build Godot for DX12. I built it with everything including Mesa, Agility SDK & PIX.
Then run: `godot-4.5.beta.dx_console.exe --rendering-driver d3d12`

I don't have any. Ask for build if needed.
